Manchester United: Eddie Howe compensation fee to Newcastle revealed - Paper Talk
Plus: Julian Nagelsmann linked with Man Utd role; Thomas Frank among potential candidates should Crystal Palace sack Pierre Sage; INEOS put FC Lausanne-Sport up for sale; El Clasico fallout continues
Monday 26 October 2026 23:11, UK
The top stories and transfer rumours from Tuesday's newspapers...
MAN UTD
Manchester United would have to fork out up to £6m in compensation to Newcastle United to land Eddie Howe if they wanted to replace Michael Carrick with him - The Telegraph
Eddie Howe has been watching Manchester United matches and making notes - The Sun
Eddie Howe may insist on bringing his complete backroom staff should he receive an approach from Manchester United - The Express
Eddie Howe and Julian Nagelsmann have backing at Man United if Carrick is axed - The Times
Sir Jim Ratcliffe's INEOS, Manchester United's minority owner, has put Swiss Super League side FC Lausanne-Sport up for sale - The Athletic

PREMIER LEAGUE
Manchester City owner Sheikh Mansour has invested a further £100million into the City Football Group as the club's appeal rolls on - The Mirror
Thomas Frank would be an alternative target for Crystal Palace to Sean Dyche if they were to sack Pierre Sage - The i Paper
Rob Edwards has rejected an approach from Burnley as a potential replacement for sacked Nicky Hayen - The Telegraph
Burnley have appointed Diego Lopez as their new chief football officer as he assesses candidates to become their next manager - Daily Mail
EUROPE
LaLiga will report the alleged assault on Eduardo Camavinga with a flagpole by a Barcelona supporter during Real Madrid's Clasico win - The Athletic
